REQUIRED_ANSWER_does_3c3c243d_affect_the.question: The dispatch requires this stated explicitly in CP2. The integration seat believes 3c3c243d has no effect on the bake and marked that belief UNVERIFIED.
REQUIRED_ANSWER_does_3c3c243d_affect_the.answer: NO EFFECT ON THE BAKE. The belief is correct, and it is now measured rather than believed.
REQUIRED_ANSWER_does_3c3c243d_affect_the.why: 3c3c243d modifies exactly one file, .github/workflows/cloud-run-deploy-smartsite-mcp.yml (+2/-2, per gh api .../commits/3c3c243d). Two independent reasons it cannot reach the image: (1) a YAML workflow file is not a JS module, so it cannot appear in the import graph esbuild bundles into /app/bakes; (2) Dockerfile.publish's final stage (lines 17-24) copies only /ldt/node_modules and /app/bakes from the earlier stages, so the workflow file is not present in the shipped image at all even as an inert byte.
REQUIRED_ANSWER_does_3c3c243d_affect_the.onlyResidualEffect: Changing any file in the LDT checkout changes the `COPY ldt/ ./` layer's input in the ldt-deps stage and therefore busts that layer's build cache. That changes build time, not built behaviour, and is not an effect on the bake.
REQUIRED_ANSWER_does_3c3c243d_affect_the.priorArtAgrees: cloudbuild.publish.yaml's own CTX-LEAVES comment (lines 31-36 before this change) had already asserted the same thing from the file list. This checkpoint re-derives it from the import graph and the Dockerfile stages rather than inheriting it.

FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.severity: material -- it contradicts the stated reason this lane was urgent
FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.dispatchClaim: '69de8fe6 is CTX-MIRROR. Production cortex-api-00754-feg is ALREADY built from it. So the serve projects the rail's own refused state while the bake, pinned to 301bb75a, does not write it. The bake is behind the serve on the exact field the zoning walk grades. Any BP-CONTENT-01 result taken on the current pin is measured with a bake and a serve that disagree.'
FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.measured: 69de8fe6 modifies four files: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/parcelRecordCellRead.ts, artifacts/api-server/src/lib/structuralFactToFacetsWire.ts, and the two matching .test.ts files. Neither source file is in the publish image's bake graph.
FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.method: The publish image's LDT content is not the LDT checkout. Dockerfile.publish:17-24 copies only /ldt/node_modules and /app/bakes; /app/bakes is produced by scripts/build-publish-bake-clis.mjs, whose entryPoints map (lines 27-32) is exactly four files: nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts, nodeFacetBakeTier2ConformantCli.ts, parcelsPmtilesBakeCli.ts, nodeFacetPatchCadRollFromCadPropertyCli.ts. esbuild runs with bundle:true and conditions:['workspace'], so the shipped bake is the transitive import graph of those four. That graph was traced at LDT 3885efad by reading each module with `git show <sha>:<path>` -- no checkout, no fetch, no write to legacy-design-tools: 26 modules, 0 unresolved relative specifiers, resolving NodeNext-style '.js' specifiers back to their '.ts' sources.

result.nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant_ts: REACHED (nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts -> lib/nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant.ts) -- so 3885efad DOES change the bake

FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.corroboration: Repo-wide at 3885efad, every non-test importer of those two files is under artifacts/api-server/src/lib/*Fact*.ts or artifacts/api-server/src/routes/, none of which is among the 26. No package under lib/ imports either file; the only lib/ references to artifacts/api-server are prose comments. The bake graph's workspace specifiers (@workspace/adapters, @workspace/cad-ingest, @workspace/cad-ingest/zoning-layers per pnpm-workspace.yaml, plus the external @empressaio/atom-contract) resolve to lib/adapters and lib/cad-ingest, neither of which reaches back into api-server sources.
FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.consequence: Bumping the pin from 301bb75a to 3885efad does not change the bake with respect to 69de8fe6, before or after. The refused zoning state is written by hauska-factory's own parcel-r5-zoning job (UPDATE_ZONING_CELLS_SQL, named in the rescued config's header), not by the LDT bake. Whatever bake/serve disagreement exists on that field, this pin is not the lever that closes it.
FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.whatThisDoesAndDoesNotProve: It proves the code is not in the bundle. It does NOT prove no bake/serve disagreement exists on the refused state by some other mechanism, and it does NOT say the pin bump was wrong -- 3885efad reaches the bake on its own merits, which is the justification written into the pin comment. What it removes is the URGENCY argument as stated.
FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.evidentiaryStandard: DEV_PROCESS 3.2a -- quotes source and names files and lines: Dockerfile.publish:17-24, scripts/build-publish-bake-clis.mjs:27-32.
FINDING_69de8fe6_also_does_not_reach_the.recommendationToTheIntegrationSeat: Do not carry forward 'the rebuild closes the bake/serve gap on the refused state' as a reason to expect a BP-CONTENT-01 change. Expect the rebuild to change retirement behaviour and nothing else on this axis. If BP-CONTENT-01 results still disagree after the rebuild, this finding says the pin was never the variable.
